usage: Illustrative real photography for the fictional NPP Caprica 2072 website. The people and locations shown are not represented as party endorsers or documentary evidence of events in Caprica.
processing: Resized from source CDN; converted to progressive optimized JPEG. No generated imagery or compositing.
